response.sql: WITH dept AS (SELECT mj.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY mj.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM dept) AS share FROM dept), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
